evidence: Identity now sourced by name, not only by place and length: three news reports name "predor V Zideh" on the regional road Trojane to Izlake (the road OSM tags 221), in the Municipality of Lukovica. No source gives a coordinate, a road number or a length for the named tunnel, so the exact way is confirmed by road + municipality + settlement, not by coordinate. Context distances from the stored point: V Zideh settlement (mdwiki) 320 m; Structurae east portal coordinate of the A1 Trojane tunnel 141 m. I found no statement that it is the only tunnel on that road within Lukovica.
